architecture_gate.chosen: Minimal security and contract patch to existing Claude Code skill; no new browser capability or website rewrite.
alternatives: Browser MCP alone (rejected: inconsistent permissions and less reproducible, MCP optional later)
full-page crawler (rejected: excessive scope and side effects)
no browser adapter (rejected: no rendered viewport observation)
architecture_gate.rationale: Bottleneck-first routing and explicit zero-change outcome give a compact, contextual workflow.
architecture_gate.strongest_counterargument: Unit and mutation gates cannot protect against all untrusted web execution; publication evidence files can be fabricated; no Claude Code or real-site E2E.

craftsmanship_gate.scope_and_disclosure: Preserved 4 modes and previous behavior; added v2 publication gate, strict CTA targets and executable browser security checks.
craftsmanship_gate.failure_mode_chain: arbitrary remote browsing -> GET or JS side effects, leaked content, unapproved scope -> mitigated by localhost default, explicit HTTPS opt-in, no clicks, method/origin/redirect/WebSocket blocks, no session profile and NOT_TESTED where interactions needed

corrections: No promised conversion uplift or fabricated psych effect score
SRM check documented using Microsoft Research (not claimed sufficient alone)
44px design preference kept distinct from WCAG minimum
Non-UI bottlenecks explicitly returned rather than disguised as UX
Validation reports explicitly limit conclusions to static evidence
No real URL audit or conversion uplift claimed; administrator-blocked live Chromium navigation explicitly recorded as NOT_TESTED

security_gate.boundary: Mandatory executed policy and mutation tests; local/remote observational limits unchanged; no network sandbox.

anti_sycophancy.notes: Does not promise an indispensable skill or guaranteed conversion increase; actively allows NO_CHANGE and RESEARCH_FIRST.

remaining_risks: Observer and selection bias during audit
Domain transfer from shopping research to high-consideration B2B
Confirmation bias from focusing only on chosen bottleneck; mitigated by strongest alternative explanation
Self-reported user research quality may be low
Automated DOM heuristics cannot prove comprehensibility, persuasive effectiveness, or usability for disabled users

eval_gate.scope: 50/50 policy fixtures, 7 spec adversarial tests, mandatory browser policy+mutation tests and 9 validators; no Claude runtime or remote browser E2E.

assumptions: Python 3 used only for optional local tests
Claude Code custom skills loaded from skill folder according to checked official docs
No target client website, permissions, analytics or controlled A/B experiment provided
source_needed: Authenticated site data and genuine customer proof
Actual before-after or randomized test to claim uplift
Real Claude Code runtime with Playwright and an authorized staging URL for network E2E and user-path QA
known_limits: Browser routing has no absolute read-only guarantee; GET JS side effects possible
CDN cross-origin resources blocked may differ from public site appearance
Chromium localhost network smoke blocked by current runner admin policy
Mandatory negative policy tests do not substitute for network isolation
No interaction click/submit/checkout coverage in observational adapter
No real Claude Code E2E or conversion uplift observed
No real Claude Code runtime tests
Publication file presence cannot establish source authenticity or legal approval
Schema validator does not validate external marketing claims or legal compliance
